inputs.text: Wake up and look at what they are openly admitting to right in front of your face. They are pushing this so-called proposed legislation, brought out as part of her 2026 State of the State agenda, under the false flag of stopping guns sold in New York from being easily modified into illegal machine guns and establishing criminal penalties for... It is all a transparent play by the ruling elites to disarm the public and cement total control. Do not buy the official narrative for a second; every single restriction they draft is a coordinated move to strip away your rights while the real puppet masters pull the strings behind the curtain.
